items.why: 1000 is original quote. Woman says 600, but does not state it is per month. Literal reading as Q1 total makes 200/month an equal-distribution average, not an offered choice. Neither 3000 nor 100 is supported; lack of a plausible distractor does not validate D.

Enclosure stays unchanged; packing cost requested separately, not rolled together; use plain instead of printed cartons is intended; revised quote via email, not regular mail. ASR remains lexically unstable, including the speaker pronoun and cartons.
Will email by tomorrow afternoon; first quarter is the forecasting horizon; no order trigger or six-month delay. Passage-level hold only.
Cannot upload the report; can open folder. No inability to attend the meeting or contact manager. Passage-level hold only.
Read-only access is suggested, not confirmed. Server is running; no printing or cancellation issue. Passage-level hold only.

Intended two requested items are folder name and managerial approval; password, printed validation report (or old all-project-files printout), and shipping address unsaid. And/in still unresolved, materially relevant to this item. Write/right homophone alone does not count as acoustic mismatch: contrasted with read-only, request write access is unambiguous.
